basic_details.job_title: ATMA Khunti Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 13 Accountant cum Clerk, Block Technical Manager and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Block Technical Manager (BTM), Assistant Technical Manager (ATM), Accountant-cum-Clerk
basic_details.short_information: Agricultural Technology Management Agency (ATMA), Khunti (ATMA Khunti), Jharkhand, has invited applications for 13 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 01/2026. The posts include Block Technical Manager (BTM), Assistant Technical Manager (ATM), Accountant-cum-Clerk. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 21 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand draft of any nationalised bank in favour of Project Director, ATMA, Khunti, payable at Khunti.

qualification.education_qualification: BTM: Post Graduate in Agriculture/Allied sector with Computer Skills or Agri-Graduate with at least 5 years working experience as ATM, plus 2 years experience; ATM: Graduate/Post Graduate in Agriculture/Allied sector, plus 1 year experience; Accountant-cum-Clerk: Graduate (Preferably B.Com), plus 3 years accountancy experience.

Minimum 03 Year experience of Accountancy in a reputed Organization

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated monthly emoluments: BTM Rs. 30000 , ATM Rs. 25000 , Accountant-cum-Clerk Rs. 22500

how_to_apply: Obtain the application form from https://www.atmakhunti.co.in/ or the Khunti district website https://khunti.nic.in.
Attach self-attested copies of mark sheets, residential, caste, local, work experience and computer proficiency certificates.
Attach the specimen affidavit typed on non-judicial stamp paper, attested by a Magistrate/Notary.
Enclose a Rs. 500/- demand draft in favour of Project Director, ATMA, Khunti, payable at Khunti.
Write the name of the post applied for on the envelope.
Send by registered post/speed post to reach Project Director, ATMA Khunti by 21.12.2026, 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: How Will ATMA Khunti Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit list out of 100 marks (educational qualification, computer knowledge, work experience, special weightage) Computer Skill Test Verification of computer proficiency and certificates by the selection committee Total 100 marks: educational qualification, computer knowledge, work experience and 10 marks special weightage for 02 years or more in ATMA/SAMETI Experience marks: Gov. Sector 4 marks per year, Semi Gov. 4 marks per 2 years, Pvt Sector 4 marks per 3 years Compiled list of applications issued with time for objections/error correction, then list for Computer Skill Test Computer proficiency and certificates checked by the selection committee

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Residential, caste and local resident certificates Work experience certificate with last three months' Bank Statement / Pay Slip Computer proficiency certificate Affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper as per specimen, attested by Magistrate/Notary Demand draft of Rs. 500/- and passport size colour photograph 4cm x 5cm

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ATMA Khunti Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form from https://www.atmakhunti.co.in/ or the Khunti district website https://khunti.nic.in. Attach self-attested copies of mark sheets, residential, caste, local, work experience and computer proficiency certificates. Attach the specimen affidavit typed on non-judicial stamp paper, attested by a Magistrate/Notary. Enclose a Rs. 500/- demand draft in favour of Project Director, ATMA, Khunti, payable at Khunti. Write the name of the post applied for on the envelope. Send by registered post/speed post to reach Project Director, ATMA Khunti by 21.12.2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ATMA Khunti Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ATMA Khunti Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies: 1 Block Technical Manager (BTM), 11 Assistant Technical Manager (ATM), 1 Accountant-cum-Clerk.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ATMA Khunti Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Pages 4-5 of this notice; also at https://www.atmakhunti.co.in/ or https://khunti.nic.in) and send it to Project Director, ATMA Khunti, Sanyukt Krishi Bhawan, First Floor, Chaibasa Road, Khunti, PIN 835210, by registered post / speed post, to reach by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: Rs. 500 (Non Refundable).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 30000 for Block Technical Manager (BTM), Rs. 25000 for Assistant Technical Manager (ATM), Rs. 22500 for Accountant-cum-Clerk.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: BTM: Post Graduate in Agriculture/Allied sector with Computer Skills or Agri-Graduate with at least 5 years working experience as ATM, plus 2 years experience; ATM: Graduate/Post Graduate in Agriculture/Allied sector, plus 1 year experience; Accountant-cum-Clerk: Graduate (Preferably B.Com), plus 3 years accountancy experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Local resident certificate issued by SDO on or after 02.06.2016, or by Circle Officer on or after 19.07.2019. EWS reservation needs Income and Asset Certificate issued by DC/SDO/Circle Officer. District reservation roster issued by Government of Jharkhand applies.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not local residents of Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list out of 100 marks (educational qualification, computer knowledge, work experience, special weightage). Computer Skill Test. Verification of computer proficiency and certificates by the selection committee. Total 100 marks: educational qualification, computer knowledge, work experience and 10 marks special weightage for 02 years or more in ATMA/SAMETI.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract-based, initially for one year, may be extended every year on the basis of Performance Appraisal Report. Selected candidate must sign a contract agreement with the Project Director, ATMA. Contract starts from the date of the agreement.
